assertions.name: algebra_survives_geometry_vanishes
assertions.detail: algebraic quantum volume (tr_M) non-zero while hyperbolic volume = 0

precisionMetadata.note: stdlib Decimal; exact Laurent coefficients (h^2+1, h) are convention-robust

description: Electron knot = trefoil 3_1 = T(2,3): NON-hyperbolic (Seifert-fibered) so Vol_hyp = 0, yet its algebraic invariant tr_M(sigma^3) = (h^2+1)z + h and Jones polynomial are non-zero at q_0. Substantiates the complex-volume 𝔙 = E0*tr_M((Pi_free-1)∘M) point for a primitive knot: the algebraic quantum volume survives where the geometric (hyperbolic) volume degenerates. Hecke/Markov conventions per AGENTS.md §7a.

parameters.braid_word: sigma^3 in B_2 (equivalently sigma_0 sigma_1 sigma_0 in B_3)

data.jones_convention: V(3_1)(t) = -t^-4 + t^-3 + t^-1 (left trefoil), t = q_0
